<!-- gateway-routing:begin (generated by render_routing.py from each CLI's --help; edit the CLIs or routing.config.json, never this block) -->
Gateways are CLIs on PATH: call them through Bash, never their HTTP APIs. Long jobs: `--no-wait` prints a jobId, `wait <jobId>` resumes.
`agw` — plain HTTP client for the agent-gateway job server (exit 0 job done · 1 job failed/interrupted/cancelled · 2 usage error or policy refusal · 3 server unreachable)
  agw check [--repo R] [--commands "a,b"]   run validation in a repo
  agw review [--repo R] [--scope S | --pr N | --branch B]   multi-angle review
  agw status|wait <jobId>   one-shot job state; block until a job reaches a terminal state
`research` — command-line client for the research-gateway REST door (exit 0 done · 1 job error or cancelled · 2 usage/auth/refused · 3 unreachable)
  research "<query>" [--depth quick|standard|deep] [--context <text>|@file] [--key <idempotencyKey>] [--json] [--no-wait]
  research wait <jobId> [--json]
`mailgw` — read-only command-line client for the email-gateway REST door (exit 0 ok · 1 API error · 2 usage error · 3 server unreachable)
  mailgw needs-action [--account A] [--since ISO] [--until ISO] [--limit N]   messages the classifier flagged
  mailgw search <query> [--account A] [--limit N]   full-text search over envelopes
  mailgw read <key> [--body]   one message (envelope, classification, cached body)
  mailgw list [--account A] [--direction inbound|outbound] [--since ISO] [--until ISO] [--limit N]   newest first, flags included
<!-- gateway-routing:end -->
